scope: Two development repetitions of one previously observed task; no independent task sample or method-effect estimate
hypotheses: The repaired contract can deliver a valid report within the fixed budget.
The fixed agent can read task-relevant passages beyond the opening excerpts. This requires evidence review, not merely counting reads.
transport_billing_note: Unknown or retried transport cost is not independently recoverable.
independent_variables: None; same fixed executor, task and output contract for both repetitions.
baseline_scope: Historical runs are failure context only: their output contract differs.
freeze_rule: No code, prompt, input, rubric or budget edits between the two repetitions. Retain all outcomes.
stopping_rule: Exactly two planned attempts; no replacement of failures. Stop early only for unknown billing, missing access or an external service fault; record missing outcomes.
mechanical_checks: every citation belongs to a canonical read from this run
eight requested fields tracked; presence is not correctness
descriptive_metrics: read ranges extending after line 50, explicitly a location proxy only
